_about: What each recorded line was made with: its voice id, model and tags (the tags in front of the line, or its whole performance; tools/audio/generate.mjs keeps this). A run without --force makes a line again when its record no longer matches its speaker's voice and model in sounds.json, or its direction in direction.json.

voice/gunner_382a00b2.mp3.tags: [wistfully] Stars look better from a deck. [playfully] Still. Not a bad fire, Shiny Boots.

voice/jumble_03439af4.mp3.tags: [defiant booming gravelly sinister pirate] And even if you save ONE island, I have ninety-nine more to scramble! [cackling] Ha! [doubtful] Is that right? Ninety-nine? [confused] Hold on.

voice/jumble_0a86147b.mp3.tags: [sneering gravelly sinister pirate] A brand-new crystal, for Driftwood? [mock outrage] But they've nearly finished forgetting! [whining] And I've worked so hard.

voice/jumble_0f07975e.mp3.tags: [furious bellowing gravelly sinister pirate] NOBODY CORRECTS CAPTAIN JUMBLE! [roaring] RAMMING SPEED!

voice/jumble_2115ac31.mp3.tags: [gloating gravelly sinister pirate] Soon nobody down there will remember a single word. [gleefully] Not a song, not a sum. [bitter outburst] Not even who failed the Sage exams!

voice/jumble_25b692b2.mp3.tags: [gleeful taunting gravelly sinister pirate] Good luck teaching it in pieces!

voice/jumble_2826f03e.mp3.tags: [angry menacing gravely sinister pirate] Glued your little shards back together, crystal carriers? [scoffing] How adorable! But that charming harbor's lighthouse is looking a bit... [sinister] dim.

voice/jumble_2baed609.mp3.tags: [low gravelly pirate] Irrelevant. [roaring] I'll show them IRRELEVANT!

voice/jumble_5ea38f9e.mp3.tags: [mocking gravelly sinister pirate] A kuh-NIGHT? [scoffing] Ha!

voice/jumble_7a866fc6.mp3.tags: [wounded theatrical gravelly sinister pirate] That took me ALL NIGHT! [pompously] Some of us have a craft!

voice/jumble_8606dda2.mp3.tags: [sulking gravelly sinister pirate] A whole DAY of bells. For a BIRD. [disgusted] And a man with a CLIPBOARD.

voice/jumble_8aaee4c5.mp3.tags: [grand theatrical gravelly sinister pirate] Ahoy, crystal carriers! [pompously] Captain Jumble, at your service!

voice/jumble_8fb2ca9f.mp3.tags: [roaring gravelly sinister pirate] INSPECTOR! [cackling] You dropped your PAPERWORK!

voice/jumble_965de3ed.mp3.tags: [outraged theatrical gravelly sinister pirate] An AUDIT? Of the MISSPELLED? [roaring] You tin-faced filing cabinet!

voice/jumble_ba1e6c8d.mp3.tags: [mocking gravelly sinister pirate] A kuh-NIGHT. [scoffing] Of course.

voice/jumble_c57d6066.mp3.tags: [gleeful taunting gravelly sinister pirate] CLAMP. Scramble it, and what do you get? [cackling] P. CLAM!

voice/jumble_d2bb738f.mp3.tags: [sneering gravelly sinister pirate] The crystal carriers! Still in one piece. [scoffing] Mostly.

voice/jumble_ed25c41e.mp3.tags: [grand theatrical gravelly sinister pirate] Set course for Smoke Mountain! [doubtful] Which side is left? [confused] Hold on.

voice/knight_10f0306d.mp3.tags: [moved] He has a shield. [proudly] Kit, he has a shield.

voice/spellwright_09b45440.mp3.tags: [delighted] Ooh, campfire. Two small words, sharing one warm seat. [fondly] Goodnight, all.

voice/swordmaster_18a73289.mp3.tags: [theatrically] You fight like a... like a... [frustrated] Blast! It's right there!
